dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL; uses COPY with REPLACING using // delimiters, INDEXED files, no EXEC SQL/CICS
evidence: SELECT ... ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC
no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS, no COMP-3

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) electronic file creation for the JMA ORCA standard receipt software system
purpose.summary: ORCR0555 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates electronic receipt (レセプト電算ファイル) data. It reads from multiple indexed receipt-related files (RECE41, RECE43, RECE44, RECE45, RECE455) and produces output for medical insurance claim submissions, handling disease names, medical procedures, costs, and various Japanese medical insurance billing rules.

notable_features: 48 COPY statements with REPLACING using // delimiter style
Multiple INDEXED files with DYNAMIC access
Large working storage with extensive flag, index, and work areas
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
561 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
6727 total lines indicating large production program
Revision history spanning 2013-2017 with named maintainers
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC or Shift-JIS encoded comments appearing as mojibake. This is the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt software, a well-known Japanese healthcare IT system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 309472 bytes total; full program is much larger. No COMP-3 is unusual for financial data but consistent with GnuCOBOL ORCA codebase style.
